indicator_name: Institutional sector accounts: disposable income, final consumption, saving, net lending by sector; household saving rate, annual
description: Счета институциональных секторов: располагаемый доход, конечное потребление, сбережение, чистое кредитование по секторам; норма сбережения домашних хозяйств, ежегодно
methodology: BNS bulletin «Национальные счета Республики Казахстан (2010-2024гг.)», element 358455 (released 2025-12-22; the next edition will be a new element -- this one then stops updating and the element_id must be changed). One sheet per year, integrated economic accounts; each item is <SNA code>.<sector> (S11 non-financial corporations, S12 financial corporations, S13 general government, S14 households, S15 NPISH, S1 total economy, S2 rest of the world). 2024: household gross disposable income 61 823 778, household final consumption 73 171 015, household gross saving -6 778 304 million KZT; HH_SAVING_RATE (SNA definition, B8g / (B6g + D8)) -10.2 % in 2024, +7.0 % in 2015. B9 equals NET_LENDING_BY_SECTOR (Taldau 701002, from 1993).
